label: Program edit locality
title: A spatial program needs an explicit edit budget
kind: Exact locality and dimensional information-budget constraints
summary: Finite-speed propagation rules out finite-support global reprogramming at a common finite cadence. A linear input footprint also cannot supply independent area information; local program fields and explicit resource budgets keep the spatial-program search well posed.
takeaway: Specify where a program acts, how its edits propagate, and which independent inputs are supplied before demanding recursive spatial closure.
